description: This file contains implementations of functions related to data transmission over websockets in the libwebsockets project. It includes functions for issuing raw data, writing data, reading and writing over SSL (non-SSL variants), and handles socket I/O, buffering, and protocol-specific behaviors.

methods.name: int lws_issue_raw(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Sends raw data over a websocket connection, handling buffering, SSL, and protocol-specific transmission details. Returns number of bytes sent or -1 on error.

methods.name: int lws_write(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len,enum lws_write_protocol wp)
methods.description: High-level function to write data using the current role's write protocol, delegating to lws_issue_raw or role-specific write functions.

methods.name: int lws_ssl_capable_read_no_ssl(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from the socket in non-SSL mode, handling UDP and non-blocking errors.

methods.name: int lws_ssl_capable_write_no_ssl(struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes data to the socket in non-SSL mode, handling UDP, file, and socket writes, with error handling.

methods.name: int lws_ssl_pending_no_ssl(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Returns the number of pending SSL data bytes; here, it returns 100 as a placeholder.

ctags.name: lws_write
ctags.signature: (struct lws * wsi,unsigned char * buf,size_t len,enum lws_write_protocol wp)
